substack_post.title: Who stays in control when AI enters everyday work?
substack_post.subtitle: Fourteen stories across five markets, plus research on memory for visual AI agents
substack_post.body: This week’s Brief follows AI into museum tours, university classrooms, ports, dining halls and the decisions that shape working life. Canada’s museum guides show how new tools can adapt to people. France Travail’s experiment asks who keeps control when a system reviews people. The UK banking story puts the workforce consequences in view, while China’s shipping and legal education plans show how institutions prepare for adoption. Our research pick explores whether visual AI agents can reason more effectively by keeping track of evidence across steps. Read the selected stories for the original sources, practical context and limits behind the headlines.
